188:t_2:53.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「We're the exception among exceptions, aren't we?」

188:t_2:54.en:
$$ラルク$$
「What's wrong with that? It's not like we're causing anyone trouble.」

188:t_2:55.en:
$$ラルク$$
「If $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$ show up, I'd bet the $$タイタン$$ members would fight to protect Earth too.」

188:t_2:56.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「We have no intention of stirring up trouble on our side either. In the multiverse, transferees' freedom of action is recognized, after all.」

188:t_2:57.en:
$$タケル$$
「We just wanted to know the reason. Since we're in the same world, we want to help each other as much as we can.」

188:t_2:58.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! $$ノノ$$ agrees with $$タケル$$'s opinion too!」

188:t_2:59.en:
$$チコ$$
「That's easy to say, but sometimes the other side doesn't want to be friends with us, you know.」

188:t_2:60.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$$明神タケル$$... Do you intend to get along even with people like those $$サイデリアル$$?」

188:t_2:61.en:
$$タケル$$
「It's different if the other side is an invader. I intend to fight evil with my life on the line.」

188:t_2:62.en:
$$タケル$$
「I swore to $$マーグ$$'s soul that I would bring peace to the universe.」

188:t_2:64.en:
$$タケル$$
「My twin older brother. He's no longer in this world, though...」

188:t_2:66.en:
$$タケル$$
「Don't worry about it. $$マーグ$$'s soul is still alive inside me.」

188:t_2:68.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「To think that after $$ノノ$$, even $$チコ$$ would fall for him. He must be quite the operator.」

188:t_2:72.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Hey! We're about to descend into the atmosphere! Everyone, to your stations!」

188:t_2:74.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Well then, everyone in the $$クラッシャー隊$$. If there's anything you'd like to ask about $$タイタン$$, feel free to call on me again.」

188:t_2:75.en:
$$勝平$$
「Big Bro $$ニコラ$$ is putting on airs as usual.」

188:t_2:76.en:
$$恵子$$
「But he's kind of dreamy. Always so full of composure.」

188:t_2:77.en:
$$勝平$$
「He's like Big Bro $$万丈$$ in that way.」

188:t_2:81.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「Then let's take our stations too. As soon as we descend into the atmosphere, the next operation begins.」

188:t_2:82.en:
$$タケル$$
(That man, $$ニコラ$$... He's hiding something...)

188:t_2:83.en:
$$タケル$$
(He's put up a wall around his heart, so I couldn't read him well, but that was...)

188:t_10:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Don't let what $$尸空#pilot$$ said get to you.」

188:t_10:6.en:
$n
「...But it's true that I'm less experienced than $$セツコ$$ and $$ランド$$. I admit that.」

188:t_10:7.en:
$n
「But the one thing I won't accept is the claim that surpassing $$ガドライト#pilot$$ is impossible.」

188:t_10:8.en:
$n
「Not with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ having staked his life for me.」

188:t_10:13.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Was that just now... by any chance... applause?」

188:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes! I, $$ＡＧ$$, was deeply moved by your words, $n.」

188:t_10:15.en:
$n
「If you're praising me, that means some $$Ｚチップ$$ were produced, right?」

188:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「When $$セツコ$$, $$ランド$$ and $n went up against that $$尸空#pilot$$... the $$スフィア$$ resonance produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z.」

188:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add these to the unit's stock as well.」

188:t_10:18.en:
$n
「Z-Chips get produced when $$スフィア$$s resonate?」

188:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, about that... I don't quite understand it myself, but let's just say all's well that ends well.」

188:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, I have to get the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ ready to open for business, so please excuse me.」

188:t_10:23.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hey, $n... Is $$ＡＧ$$ still unable to reach the company?」

188:t_10:25.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$n... Maybe you should be a little careful about what $$ＡＧ$$ does...」

188:t_10:26.en:
$n
「You mean $$ＡＧ$$ is going to betray us?」

188:t_10:27.en:
$$ランド$$
「No... that's not it. Maybe we only feel this way because we haven't known $$ＡＧ$$ long, but... $$ＡＧ$$ is hiding something.」

188:t_10:29.en:
$n
(Deep down, I've always had something nagging at me...)

188:t_10:30.en:
$n
(But since I don't want to lose $$ジェニオン$$, maybe I've been looking away from doubting $$ＡＧ$$...)

188:t_10:31.en:
$n
(No, that's not it... I must want to believe in $$ＡＧ$$...)

188:t_10:37.en:
$$タケル$$
「It's been a while, $$ＡＧ$$. Good to see you're doing well.」

188:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$タケル$$... I have something I'd like to discuss with you in earnest.」

188:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Would you be willing to train $n yourself?」

188:t_10:44.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes... With a strong spirit like yours, I believe $n could climb to even greater heights.」

188:t_10:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course, I will pay whatever reward I can myself...」

188:t_10:46.en:
$$タケル$$
「...I don't need anything like that. $n is my comrade.」

188:t_10:48.en:
$$タケル$$
「Besides, I'm not the only one who'll be training him. $$アルト$$, $$甲児$$, $$宗介$$, $$カミーユ$$, $$シン$$, $$カレン$$, $$竜馬$$, Captain $$アムロ$$, Major $$オズマ$$...」

188:t_10:49.en:
$$タケル$$
「Everyone is his coach, his mentor, and his comrade.」

188:t_10:51.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That light of yours, $$タケル$$... Someday it will surely help $n.」

188:t_10:53.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「By the way, I have one more favor to ask...」
